summary: Iteration 4 — focused testing of v6 custom Word template management. Backend: 10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_user_templates.py all pass (upload+LLM detection, list/get/404/auth, PATCH persistence + type sanitization, /api/templates custom_templates, chat creation greeting, preview ph-empty/ph-filled, image upload + injection, docxtpl download with word/media + filled values, PDF-blocked 400, delete). Frontend: /templates page, field editor dialog, sidebar quick buttons, template selector 'Word Kütüphaneniz' section, custom mammoth preview with amber/green placeholders, image slot file-chooser upload, AI message field fill, and .docx download all verified via Playwright. No blocking defects; two security scoping gaps and one date-format nit reported.

minor.issue: No user_id scoping — any authenticated user can list/read/preview and start chats with ANY user's uploaded template (find({}) with no user filter). PATCH/DELETE do check ownership, so the model is inconsistent. Multi-tenant data leak.
No authentication/ownership check — verified 200 for an unauthenticated curl on another user's uploaded image (IDOR). Preview needs it public, so consider a signed/opaque token or cookie-auth check.
preview_html emits relative image src '/api/uploads/file/...'; works only because frontend and backend share the origin. Should be built from an absolute backend URL for robustness.
Date fields are stored normalized to ISO (typed '15.08.2026' -> preview shows '2026-08-15'). For a Turkish Word report the rendered value should likely stay dd.MM.yyyy.

issues: Contrast is fine (amber #fef3c7/#92400e, green #dcfce7/#14532d). Only nit: filled image slot chip switches to green but no thumbnail/remove affordance to replace a wrongly uploaded image.

action_items: Scope user_templates list/get/preview (and /api/templates custom_templates) to the requesting user_id, and reject chat creation with someone else's user_template_id.
Protect GET /api/uploads/file/{upload_id} (auth or unguessable signed URL) — currently open IDOR.
Return absolute (env-based) URLs for preview image src instead of relative /api paths.
Decide date rendering format for custom templates (Turkish dd.MM.yyyy vs ISO).
Optional: allow replacing/removing an uploaded image slot value from the preview bar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1390 lines — split user_templates endpoints into a dedicated router module.
`import shutil` sits at line 394 (mid-file, after being used in delete_user_template) — move to the top imports.

apply_placeholders line 240: `p.runs[0].text = token if p.runs else p.add_run(token).text` is dead/confusing (the guard is already false when p.runs is empty) followed by a redundant `if not p.runs` block — simplify.
render_docx relies on Jinja default Undefined for unfilled keys; add an explicit context default per field so a future StrictUndefined/typo doesn't 500 the download.
seed_data_creation: Reused seeded template 'Test Konut Şablonu' (11 fields). Uploaded + deleted one TEST_Upload Sablonu docx (1 LLM call). Test chats created by pytest were deleted; 1-2 UI-created chats with a 1x1 TEST png remain in the sidebar.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_user_templates.py with -n 0; the upload test costs 1 Claude call (deselect with -k 'not upload_detect' to skip). Preview/chat/image/download all validated against the seeded utpl template. Playwright auth = add cookie session_token before goto. Remaining open items are ownership scoping on user_templates and IDOR on /api/uploads/file.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found. Scoping gaps stem from db.user_templates.find({}) / find_one({template_id}) queries omitting user_id, while PATCH/DELETE add an explicit owner check; serve_upload intentionally has no Depends(get_current_user) so that preview tags load, which exposes any upload_id publicly.
